key_facts: Checked Tuesday July 7 (T+1d to Wednesday July 8 11:15 a.m. CT sentencing before U.S. District Judge Lynn Adelman in Milwaukee): July 6 Spectrum News 1 and July 7 Latin Times confirm sentencing remains on schedule for Wednesday July 8 with no new court filings, reply briefs, or postponement. Pre-July 4 sentencing memoranda remain the operative record: PSR federal guidelines are 15-21 months (5-yr statutory max); prosecutors (EAUSA Richard Frohling) sought a 15-21 month guideline / 'meaningful' and 'serious' sentence stressing abuse of judicial oath and lack of remorse ('no one is above the law'); defense disputed guidelines (arguing 0-6 months), submitted ~20 support letters (ex-DA E. Michael McCann, former Mayor Tom Barrett, etc.), noted Dugan (67, no record, resigned in Jan) was publicly handcuffed and forced from her home due to threats, and explicitly requested 'time served' (<1 day custody). UW Law prof John Gross said he would be 'very surprised' by incarceration, and Judge Adelman frequently varies below federal guidelines. Forecast unchanged ahead of tomorrow's sentencing.
